scope: passive public Claude web quality evidence from workflow run 29665084768

findings.title: Claude public login shell is a bounded mobile-lab performance outlier
findings.claim: In the exact bounded Lighthouse run, the unauthenticated Claude shell redirected to /login and produced LCP 33.92 seconds and TBT 3.99 seconds.

causal_memory.surface_scope: unauthenticated Claude public shell redirected to /login
causal_memory.state_scope: single exact Lighthouse mobile-lab packet; not field telemetry

user_control.user_effect: A visitor waits for the login surface without a clear explanation of whether the product is still loading.

findings.minimal_fix: Treat the unauthenticated login shell as a dedicated performance budget and reduce the initial JavaScript execution and transfer path.
findings.regression_test: Repeat the exact bounded mobile profile three times and require a stable LCP candidate, median LCP within budget, and materially lower unused-JavaScript opportunity.

findings.title: Claude product overview combines severe lab LCP delay with accessibility findings
findings.claim: The exact bounded run measured LCP 41.43 seconds, Performance 29, Accessibility 73, and a 2.43-second render-blocking opportunity on the Claude product overview.

causal_memory.state_scope: single exact Lighthouse mobile-lab packet; not field telemetry

user_control.user_effect: The principal product message arrives late, while semantic and contrast defects may reduce inspectability for some visitors.

findings.minimal_fix: Prioritize the exact LCP path, remove avoidable render-blocking work, and repair the bounded accessibility failures.
findings.regression_test: Run three bounded mobile audits and require a stable LCP element, median LCP within budget, Accessibility above the agreed threshold, and no recurrence of the identified semantic failures.

findings.title: Client JavaScript cost recurs across Claude public surfaces
findings.claim: Unused JavaScript recurs in six of seven Claude packets, while boot-time and bfcache findings recur in five of seven; this supports a shared contributor pattern without asserting one root cause for every runtime.

causal_memory.surface_scope: Claude public shell, product, docs, help, and status portfolio
causal_memory.state_scope: cross-surface recurrence; runtimes remain causally separate

user_control.user_effect: Repeated client-runtime cost delays access to product, documentation, help, and status information, but exact user impact differs by surface.

findings.minimal_fix: Create runtime-specific JavaScript budgets and remove unused or early-loaded bundles before treating the portfolio as one implementation.
findings.regression_test: Re-run the seven-target portfolio and require fewer recurring unused-JavaScript, boot-time, and bfcache findings without collapsing distinct runtimes into one cause.

findings.title: Claude Status has bounded accessibility and best-practice defects
findings.claim: The exact bounded run measured Accessibility 83 and Best Practices 79 on Claude Status, including contrast and semantic findings that can reduce inspectability.

user_control.user_effect: Users relying on status information may have more difficulty inspecting service state because of contrast and semantic defects.

findings.minimal_fix: Repair the exact contrast and semantic failures and keep live versus historical status information structurally clear.
findings.regression_test: Re-run the public status page and require Accessibility and Best Practices above threshold with the identified findings absent.

findings.title: Claude Code Performance zero is not publishable as a confirmed defect
findings.claim: The reported Lighthouse Performance score of zero proves a severe Claude Code product-page performance defect.

causal_memory.state_scope: exact packet with missing LCP and TBT; score zero is not a valid severity proxy

user_control.user_effect: The product-page user impact cannot be assigned until the missing LCP measurement is reproduced or explained.

findings.minimal_fix: Repeat the exact page run with trace inspection and determine why Lighthouse emitted no LCP candidate before assigning a product defect.
findings.regression_test: Require at least two valid runs with non-null LCP and TBT before the performance score can support a confirmed finding.
